title: Compliance checks: alternative dispute resolution — CC/FS21
text: Factsheets are for guidance only and reflect HMRC’s position at the time of writing.
changeNote: The ‘Alternative dispute resolution — CC/FS21’ factsheet has been updated with revised guidance on when to apply for Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR), how to apply, the types of disputes suitable for ADR and what to expect during the ADR process.
